_comment: Runtime distributions bundled into the shipped Python embeddable. Derived from the import closure of api.main:app plus uvicorn (see deploy/README.md). Keep this list minimal: every entry adds size to the release artifact and Gitee caps a single attachment at 100MB.

excluded_by_design.PySide6: legacy desktop GUI — the web dashboard replaced it
excluded_by_design.playwright: browser automation, only used by the retired collector flows
excluded_by_design.uiautomator2: device automation — installed only on executor machines
excluded_by_design.adbutils: device automation — installed only on executor machines
excluded_by_design.pillow: image processing for screenshot diffing on executor machines
